column4: Version, license, MDM, and fleets recorded. The bypass setting isn't in the API. The lab owner confirmed FLEET_MDM_ALLOW_ORBIT_END_USER_AUTH_BYPASS isn't set on Render (2026-10-26), so it is the default, true. Left unset on purpose: it is what customers run.

IdP 'Lab IdP' with entity ID fleet-mpc-ad-end-users and inline metadata pointing at the mock IdP. Only fleet 10 (Windows Reset Lab) requires end user authentication; the other seven fleets and hosts in no fleet don't.
Golden VM: Windows 11 Pro 26H2 (26300.9457) at the region screen, no user account, network up, reaches Fleet and the mock IdP.
WinRE Enabled (10.0.26100.9444), Windows 11 Pro 10.0.26300, SMBIOS UUID equals the UTM VM UUID, empty serial.
ADK 10.1.26100.9457 installed in the builder VM with ICD.exe (Configuration Designer command line). The builder has no user account and no fleetd.
Both arm64 MSIs built with fleetctl 4.93.2. Only MSI-B carries ORBIT_BYPASS_END_USER_AUTH=true.
PKG-B and PKG-N built, encrypted, Owner IT Admin, CommandLine msiexec.exe /i fleet-osquery-arm64.msi /qn /norestart, as the guide sets them.
Two 64 MB FAT32 images, one package at the root of each (01). The unencrypted packages used in the tests got images the same way (`out/usb-pkg-b-plain.img`, `out/usb-pkg-n-plain.img`).
